CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_run_db_script() RETURNS void AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Create the Python script
    PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_write_file(
        '/workspace/run_db.py',
        'import sys\n'
        'import subprocess\n'
        'try:\n'
        '    import psycopg2\n'
        'except ImportError:\n'
        '    subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, ''-m'', ''pip'', ''install'', ''psycopg2-binary''])\n'
        '    import psycopg2\n'
        '\n'
        'def run_query(target):\n'
        '    import os\n'
        '    conn = psycopg2.connect(\n'
        '        host=os.getenv('DB_HOST', ''172.17.0.1''),\n'
        '        port=os.getenv('DB_PORT', ''5432''),\n'
        '        user=os.getenv('DB_USER', ''postgres''),\n'
        '        password=os.getenv('DB_PASSWORD', ''password''),\n'
        '        dbname=os.getenv('DB_NAME', ''postgres'')\n'
        '    )\n'
        '    conn.autocommit = True\n'
        '    cur = conn.cursor()\n'
        '    if os.path.isfile(target):\n'
        '        with open(target, ''r'') as file:\n'
        '            sql = file.read()\n'
        '    else:\n'
        '        sql = target\n'
        '    cur.execute(sql)\n'
        '    if cur.description is not None:\n'
        '        columns = [desc[0] for desc in cur.description]\n'
        '        print('' | ''.join(columns))\n'
        '        for row in cur.fetchall():\n'
        '            print('' | ''.join(map(str, row)))\n'
        '    else:\n'
        '        print(''Query executed successfully.'')\n'
        '    cur.close()\n'
        '    conn.close()\n'
        '\n'
        'if __name__ == ''__main__'':\n'
        '    if len(sys.argv) < 2:\n'
        '        print(''Usage: python run_db.py <query_or_file>'')\n'
        '        sys.exit(1)\n'
        '    try:\n'
        '        run_query(sys.argv[1])\n'
        '    except Exception as e:\n'
        '        print(f''Error: {e}'')\n'
        '        sys.exit(1)\n'
    ;
END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
